'''Daupherm''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Daupherm Planet States]]. It was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], close to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" />
